title: Correction to: Survival of elongate hemlock scale (Hemiptera: Diaspididae) with prolonged cold exposure: overwintering mortality risk across North America
content: This is a correction to: Clarissa Dahl, Brian H Aukema, Julia B Leone, Robert M Jetton, Toby R Petrice, Angie Ambourn, Robert C Venette, Survival of elongate hemlock scale (Hemiptera: Diaspididae) with prolonged cold exposure: overwintering mortality risk across North America, Environmental Entomology, Volume 54, Issue 6, December 2025, Pages 1311–1323, https://doi.org/10.1093/ee/nvaf096
